doubts: The page says the track can be walked in either direction starting from Lee Bay or Fern Gully car park, so two loop ways are given (the page's section order, Lee Bay first, is the main). The page does not say clockwise or anticlockwise. The loop is closed by the road sections Oban township to Lee Bay and Fern Gully car park to Oban township, which are described in section headings and Getting there; whether DOC's 32 km includes them is not stated. F2 (road end at Lee Bay Road) taken as Lee Bay, F1 (unnamed track at Main Road) taken as Fern Gully car park. Maori Beach creek wading is an optional low-tide alternative and is not a via. Water taxi to the huts is given as a boat exit with no specific place.
